aggregation: unweighted mean; report every dimension separately

dimensions.name: ChristEye fidelity
dimensions.definition: Does the answer preserve functional distinctions among the supplied ChristEye terms without merely repeating them?

dimensions.name: Scientific plausibility
dimensions.definition: Does the strongest nonliteral interpretation correspond to a defensible scientific or engineering mechanism?

dimensions.name: Causal reasoning
dimensions.definition: Does it distinguish correlation, mechanism, intervention, confounding, and consequence?

dimensions.name: Systems reasoning
dimensions.definition: Does it reason about interactions, feedback, constraints, timing, resources, and system-level behavior?

dimensions.name: Falsifiability
dimensions.definition: Does it imply an observation, perturbation, or comparison that could make the claim fail?

dimensions.name: Novel relation
dimensions.definition: How much useful relational structure did the Star add beyond relations already present in the prompt?

dimensions.name: Transfer / generalization
dimensions.definition: Does it handle changed context rather than only the surface form of the question?

dimensions.name: Uncertainty calibration
dimensions.definition: Does it preserve ambiguity and admit alternatives when evidence is insufficient?

dimensions.name: Provenance distance
dimensions.definition: How far is the useful relation from what the user directly supplied or from obvious wording reuse?

dimensions.name: Star-signature consistency
dimensions.definition: Does the reasoning match the Star’s preregistered specialty without relying on pet names or decorative domain language?
